sections.h2: Mills still owed farmers ₹12,779 crore in cane dues in April, despite a 14-day rule

chart.title: Cane dues fell from ₹16,087 crore in February to ₹12,779 crore by April
chart.sub: Cane dues owed by mills on each date, ₹ crore.

sections.means: Arrears persist because mills face a cash squeeze, with cane prices rising to ₹365 while the minimum sugar price has stayed at ₹31 a kilo since 2019.
sections.todo: Require a bank-guaranteed escrow for cane purchases and enforce interest on payments delayed beyond 14 days.

sections.h2: Tighter PM-KISAN lists cut paid farmers from 10.07 crore to 9.34 crore

chart.title: Payees fell by about 73 lakh between the 19th and 24th instalments
chart.sub: Farmers paid per PM-KISAN instalment, crore.
chart.source: Agriculture ministry figures, as reported in the post.

sections.means: Stricter checks removed ineligible names, but they also stopped payments to eligible farmers whose Aadhaar, e-KYC or land seeding was incomplete.
sections.todo: Publish, for each instalment, how many eligible farmers are held back and why, so the cut can be checked.

sections.h2: Farmer ID registries reached 11 crore in October, five months ahead of target

chart.title: Farmer IDs rose from 10.28 crore in July to 11 crore by 23 October
chart.sub: Farmer IDs generated under AgriStack, crore.
chart.source: Agriculture ministry, as reported in the post.

sections.means: Each Farmer ID is matched to digitised land records, so the register is only as reliable as the land records behind it.
sections.todo: Extend registration to tenants and sharecroppers, of whom only about 28,680 had been registered in five states by October.
